issues.description: The template's state_preparation function for the Lights Out puzzle uses the parameter name "switch_register" while the problem statement and the rest of the code (including the solution) consistently refer to this register as the "flip" register (flip_register). The docstring and other methods (oracle, diffusion, grover_circuit) use flip_register, causing a naming mismatch between the template signature and the expected/used identifier. This can confuse students trying to map the problem description (which names the register 'flip') to the template API and the reference solution.
issues.suggested_fix: Rename the template function parameter and its docstring to use flip_register (instead of switch_register) in template_repository/ex4_grover_lights_out_puzzle.py. Specifically, change the state_preparation signature to accept flip_register: QuantumRegister and update any docstring/parameter references to 'flip_register' so they align with the problem statement and the solution implementation. This preserves the intended API and reduces student cognitive mapping burden.
